name: omakvm
author: rob-d3v
description: One keyboard and mouse for the PCs on your network, arranged like monitors: drag each PC next to your screens and the cursor crosses the edge. Screens by Monitor Manager, network PCs by Mickey. Unofficial community plugin.

barWidget.description: Two screens; the second fills in while your keyboard is on a network PC. Click opens the layout of screens and PCs; right click the PC switcher; middle click brings the keyboard home.
